title: Imagica World Theme Park
description: India's first international-standard theme park spanning 130 acres. A landmark entertainment destination featuring world-class rides, immersive themed zones, and cutting-edge architectural design.

title: Aquasplash Water Park
description: Central Africa's premier water park destination. Designed to international standards with state-of-the-art water rides, wave pools, and leisure amenities in the heart of Kinshasa.

title: Ramoji Film City Extension
description: Expansion of the world's largest integrated film studio complex. Comprehensive architectural and project management services for new studio facilities and entertainment zones.

title: Shapoorji Pallonji Corporate HQ
description: Premium corporate headquarters featuring contemporary glass facades, sustainable design elements, and world-class interior finishes for one of India's most respected conglomerates.

title: Wonderla Amusement Park
description: Comprehensive design and project management for one of South India's most popular amusement parks, featuring innovative ride architecture and visitor experience design.

title: Malpani Greens Township
description: An integrated township development featuring premium residential towers, landscaped gardens, and world-class amenities designed for modern urban living.

title: Wilo Mather & Platt Factory
description: State-of-the-art manufacturing facility designed with precision engineering, optimized workflows, and sustainable building practices for a global pump manufacturer.

title: AGIBS Group Business Park
description: International commercial development featuring modern office spaces, retail zones, and landscaped public areas designed to the highest global standards.

title: Pune Central Hospital
description: A 300-bed multispecialty hospital featuring advanced MEP systems, patient-centric design, and efficient clinical workflows. Built to international healthcare facility standards.

title: Fundoo World Amusement Park
description: One of North India's early large-scale amusement destinations. Comprehensive architectural design encompassing ride structures, food courts, and landscaped leisure zones.

title: Bandal Landmark Residences
description: FDG's first landmark residential project on Paud Road. Premium apartments with thoughtful spatial planning and quality construction that set new standards for Pune's residential market.

title: National Institute of Technology
description: A comprehensive campus design for one of India's premier technical institutions, featuring academic blocks, hostels, laboratories, and extensive landscaped grounds.
